title: 第37章 发现一枚汉奸

第37章 发现一枚汉奸-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

上一章

存书签

下一章

顾承安又看了一遍名册，确认所有在岗人员无异常后，翻到下一页——参会人员登记表。

今天的会议九点开始，预计参会专家、嘉宾、媒体记者、志愿者、随行工作人员加起来超过三百人。

三百人。

如果按照常规安检流程，分散从东门和西门两个入口进入，他根本不可能逐一覆盖。

天珠的探测范围只有十米，两个入口同时放人，他分身乏术。

顾承安站起来，走到平面图前，盯着两个入口的位置看了看。

“封一个入口。”

魏国平问：“封哪个？”

“西门。”顾承安用笔在西门位置打了个叉，“从现在起，所有参会人员只能从东门主入口进入，西门改为应急通道，平时关闭，由专人看守。”

“所有人走一个口子？会不会慢了点？”魏国平皱眉。

“我会控制放行速度，不会太慢。”顾承安说，“但这件事没有商量余地，三百多人要从我眼前过一遍，我要亲自排查一遍。”

魏国平没再多问。

他已经隐约察觉到，这位007同志和普通的安保排查方式不太一样。

但察觉归察觉，不该问的不问，这是老兵的本分。

接下来，顾承安让亲自排查了一遍这栋楼的所有工作人员，没有发现什么问题。

七点四十分，东门入口的临时安检通道重新布置完毕。

原本二十来米宽的入口被临时护栏收窄到十米以内。

顾承安站在安检门内侧靠右的位置，这个点位经过他亲自测量过——从通道入口到他站的位置，直线距离正好九米，完全能覆盖。

任何人从通道走进来，都会被他的天珠扫一遍。

八点多，第一批参会人员到了。

几辆大巴停在会议中心门前的广场上，穿着正装的专家学者们陆续下车，志愿者举着引导牌把他们往东门方向带。

顾承安站在自己的点位上，面前摆了张小桌子，上面放着一台笔记本电脑和一沓资料，看起来就像是一个普通的会务工作人员在做最后的核对。

第一个人走进通道。

手机没有震动。

接下来第二个第三个、第四个、第五个……

全部正常。

陆鸣端了杯水过来，放在桌上，低声问道：“顺利吗？”

顾承安轻声回了句：“继续看。”

这时几个记者同行有说有笑的走了过来，聊着今天哪个专家要做主旨报告、采访机位怎么安排……

当他们走进10米范围的时候。

Gu Chengan looked at the roster again, and after confirming that there were no abnormalities among all the people on duty, he turned to the next page - the participant registration form.

Today's meeting will start at nine o'clock. It is expected that the total number of participating experts, guests, media reporters, volunteers, and accompanying staff will exceed 300.

Three hundred people.

If he followed the regular security check process and entered from the east gate and west gate, it would be impossible for him to cover them one by one.

The detection range of the Dzi Bead is only ten meters, and if people are released from two entrances at the same time, he is unable to do anything at the same time.

Gu Chengan stood up, walked to the floor plan, and stared at the locations of the two entrances.

"Seal an entrance."

Wei Guoping asked: "Which one should be sealed?"

"West Gate." Gu Chengan marked the west gate with a pen. "From now on, all participants can only enter through the main entrance of the east gate. The west gate has been changed to an emergency passage. It is usually closed and guarded by dedicated personnel."

"Everyone walks through the same opening? Isn't it a little slow?" Wei Guoping frowned.

"I will control the release speed and not be too slow." Gu Chengan said, "But this matter is non-negotiable. More than 300 people have to pass through my eyes, and I have to check it myself."

Wei Guoping didn't ask any more questions.

He has vaguely noticed that this Comrade 007 is different from the ordinary security investigation method.

But when you are aware, you are aware, and you do not ask questions that should not be asked. This is the duty of a veteran.

Next, Gu Chengan personally checked all the staff in the building and found no problems.

At 7:40, the temporary security check channel at the east gate entrance was rearranged.

The original entrance, which was about twenty meters wide, was narrowed to less than ten meters by temporary guardrails.

Gu Chengan stood on the right side of the inside of the security gate. He had personally measured this point - from the entrance of the passage to where he stood, the straight-line distance was exactly nine meters, which could be completely covered.

Anyone who walks in from the passage will be scanned by his dzi beads.

At around eight o'clock, the first batch of participants arrived.

Several buses stopped in the square in front of the conference center. Experts and scholars in formal attire got off the bus one after another, and volunteers held guide signs to lead them toward the east gate.

Gu Chengan stood at his spot with a small table in front of him, with a laptop and a stack of documents on it. He looked like an ordinary conference staff member doing final checks.

The first person walks into the passage.

The phone doesn't vibrate.

Next, the second, the third, the fourth, the fifth...

All normal.

Lu Ming brought a glass of water over, put it on the table, and asked in a low voice: "Did it go well?"

Gu Chengan replied softly: "Keep reading."

At this time, several fellow journalists came over chatting and laughing, chatting about which expert was going to give a keynote report today and how to arrange the interview slots...

When they walk within 10 meters.
